title: Cebu Greats manager proud of team's MPBL turnaround

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Cebu Greats team manager Jhon Santos expressed pride in the team’s turnaround in the Maharlika Pilipinas Basketball League (MPBL), despite falling short of a finals berth in their first full season together. In a message following the team’s semifinal exit, Santos highlighted how the Greats rose from finishing 10th last season to reaching the semifinals this year, capping a remarkable recovery for the Cebu franchise. “Our first full season together as a team, we exceeded every expectation and fought our way to the semifinals!” Santos said.
